app/api/test-nivoda/route.ts.name: Diamond search
app/api/test-nivoda/route.ts.description: Searches the Nivoda diamond marketplace for loose stones matching the customer's criteria.

app/api/tmc-matches/route.ts.name: TMC ring matches
app/api/tmc-matches/route.ts.description: Links Elysium ring designs to their TMC supplier equivalents so images and data can be imported.

app/api/tmc-review/route.ts.name: TMC ring reviews
app/api/tmc-review/route.ts.description: Lets staff browse TMC supplier rings and mark which ones to include in the Elysium catalogue.

POST /api/test-nivoda.name: Search diamonds
POST /api/test-nivoda.description: Sends a search to Nivoda and returns matching loose diamonds with prices.

GET /api/test-nivoda.name: Nivoda status
GET /api/test-nivoda.description: Checks whether the connection to the Nivoda diamond marketplace is working.

GET /api/tmc-matches.name: View ring matches
GET /api/tmc-matches.description: Returns the current mapping between Elysium designs and TMC supplier rings.

POST /api/tmc-matches.name: Save ring match
POST /api/tmc-matches.description: Links an Elysium ring design to its TMC supplier equivalent.

GET /api/tmc-review.name: TMC ring list
GET /api/tmc-review.description: Returns TMC supplier rings with their review status for the selection tool.

POST /api/tmc-review.name: Review TMC ring
POST /api/tmc-review.description: Saves a staff member's decision on whether to include a TMC ring in the catalogue.
